description: This file contains the implementation of the WebAudioPlayerTestBase class, including setup, teardown, creation, and destruction of WebAudioPlayer objects for testing purposes. It is part of a test suite for media playback components.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase
classes.description: A base class for testing WebAudioPlayer components, providing setup, teardown, and helper methods.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and configures PCM parameters for testing.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Resets mocks and cleans up resources after tests.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates and initializes a WebAudioPlayer instance with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys the WebAudioPlayer instance and cleans up.
